hints: Count and compare each symbol separately on the P side versus the Q side. Which type is higher in Q, which is higher in P, and which looks about equal?
Remember net diffusion is down a concentration gradient through a partially permeable membrane, but a molecule too large to pass will show no net movement even if a gradient exists.
walkthrough:
**Compare the numbers on each side**

Look carefully at the diagram. Small circles are more numerous in solution Q than in solution P. Ovals are only seen in solution P and none in solution Q. Squares are present in roughly equal numbers in P and Q.

**Apply diffusion and selective permeability**

Small molecules that can pass will show net movement from higher concentration to lower concentration:
$$\text{net movement = high concentration} \rightarrow \text{low concentration}$$
So circles move Q to P, and ovals move P to Q.

**Explain the squares**

Squares are too large to pass through the partially permeable membrane, or are already at equal concentration. Either way there is no net movement of squares between P and Q. This matches option B exactly.

options.A: Correct about circles and ovals direction is mixed up. Ovals have a clear P to Q gradient, so they will move, not stay still.
options.B: Correct. Circles move Q to P down their gradient, ovals move P to Q down their gradient, squares cannot cross so show no net movement.
options.C: Wrong for circles and squares. Circles are unequal so they will diffuse Q to P, not stay still.
options.D: Reversed. Circles are higher in Q so net movement is Q to P, not P to Q, and ovals are higher in P.
